zh: 當他作畫時，他能聽到距離他在吉維尼的家50公里外的槍聲。
ja: 彼が絵を描いている間、ジヴェルニーの自宅から50km離れた場所で銃声が聞こえました。
local: He could hear the sound of gunfire 50km away from his house in Giovanni as he painted.
native: He could hear the sound of gunfire 50km away from his house in Giovanni as he painted.

en: For Monet, these works would be his very personal response to the mass tragedy of the First
zh: 對莫內來說，這些作品將是他對第一次大規模悲劇的非常個人的回應，
ja: モネにとって、これらの作品は第一次世界大戦の大惨事に対する非常に個人的な応答でした。
local: For Monet, these works would be his very personal response to the mass tragedy of the First
native: For Monet, these works would be his very personal response to the mass tragedy of the First

en: World War.
zh: 世界大戰。
ja: 世界大戦です。
local: World War.
native: World War.

en: Following Armistice Day, Monet contacted Clemonso, offering a gift of two panels of large-scale
zh: 停戰日後，莫內聯繫了克萊蒙梭，提出贈送兩幅大型畫板作為禮物，
ja: 休戦日後、モネはクレマンソーに連絡し、大型の2枚のパネルを贈ることを申し出ました。
local: Following Armistice Day, Monet contacted Clemonso, offering a gift of two panels of large-scale
native: Following Armistice Day, Monet contacted Clemonso, offering a gift of two panels of large-scale

en: waterlilies to the nation.
zh: 睡蓮畫作贈予國家。
ja: 国に大型の睡蓮のパネル2枚を贈ることを申し出ました。
local: waterlilies to the nation.
native: waterlilies to the nation.

en: The county politician would soon persuade Monet to extend the gift to eight panels by appealing
zh: 這位地方政治家很快說服莫內將禮物擴大到八幅畫板，藉由激發
ja: 地方の政治家はすぐにモネを説得し、贈り物を8枚のパネルに拡大させました。
local: The county politician would soon persuade Monet to extend the gift to eight panels by appealing
native: The county politician would soon persuade Monet to extend the gift to eight panels by appealing

en: to his ego.
zh: 他的自尊心。
ja: 彼の自尊心に訴えて。
local: to his ego.
native: to his ego.

en: Clemonso despised the sculptor, August Rodin, who had once done an unflattering sculpture
zh: 克萊蒙梭鄙視雕塑家奧古斯特·羅丹，後者曾為他做過一座不討喜的雕塑，
ja: クレマンソーは彫刻家オーギュスト・ロダンを嫌っていました。ロダンはかつて彼の不評な彫刻を作りました。
local: Clemonso despised the sculptor, August Rodin, who had once done an unflattering sculpture
native: Clemonso despised the sculptor, August Rodin, who had once done an unflattering sculpture

en: of him, and Rodin had just donated his works to France for the creation of the Rodin Museum
zh: 而羅丹剛剛將他的作品捐贈給法國，用於創建羅丹博物館，
ja: 彼の彫刻を作り、ロダンはちょうど彼の作品をフランスに寄贈し、ロダン美術館の設立に使われました。
local: of him, and Rodin had just donated his works to France for the creation of the Rodin Museum
native: of him, and Rodin had just donated his works to France for the creation of the Rodin Museum

en: in Paris.
zh: 在巴黎。
ja: パリで。
local: in Paris.
native: in Paris.

en: Clemonso proposed a dedicated space to Monet for his Grand Decorations.
zh: 克萊蒙梭為莫內的「大裝飾」提議了一個專門的空間。
ja: クレマンソーはモネのグランド・デコレーションのために専用のスペースを提案しました。
local: Clemonso proposed a dedicated space to Monet for his Grand Decorations.
native: Clemonso proposed a dedicated space to Monet for his Grand Decorations.

en: Was the rivalry between the two artists, a reason that Monet was now also seeking artistic
zh: 兩位藝術家之間的競爭，是否也是莫內現在尋求藝術
ja: 二人の芸術家の間の競争が、モネが芸術的な
local: Was the rivalry between the two artists, a reason that Monet was now also seeking artistic
native: Was the rivalry between the two artists, a reason that Monet was now also seeking artistic

en: immortality in a dedicated space.
zh: 不朽的原因之一？
ja: 不朽を専用のスペースで求めている理由だったのでしょうか？
local: immortality in a dedicated space.
native: immortality in a dedicated space.

en: The Impressionist once the radical and subversive young artist who scandalized Paris
zh: 印象派曾是激進且顛覆性的年輕藝術家，震驚了巴黎
ja: 印象派はかつて、パリを騒がせた過激で破壊的な若き芸術家たちでした
local: The Impressionist once the radical and subversive young artist who scandalized Paris
ja_pron: Inshōha wa katsute, Pari o sawagase ta kageki de hakai-teki na wakaki geijutsuka-tachi deshita
native: The Impressionist once the radical and subversive young artist who scandalized Paris

en: were now the mainstream.
zh: 現在已成為主流。
ja: 今では主流となっています。
local: were now the mainstream.
ja_pron: Ima de wa shuryū to natte imasu
native: were now the mainstream.

en: New avogard movements meant Monet once the voice of rebellion now became the standard
zh: 新的前衛運動意味著莫內這位曾經的反叛之聲，現在成為了標準
ja: 新しい前衛運動は、かつて反逆の声であったモネが今や基準となったことを意味します
local: New avogard movements meant Monet once the voice of rebellion now became the standard
ja_pron: Atarashī zen'ei undō wa, katsute hangyaku no koe de atta Mone ga imaya kijun to natta koto o imi shimasu
native: New avogard movements meant Monet once the voice of rebellion now became the standard

en: to rebel against.
zh: 反叛的對象。
ja: 反抗の対象となったのです。
local: to rebel against.
ja_pron: Hankō no taishō to natta no desu
native: to rebel against.

en: His new works needed to have an impact if Monet was to be as relevant in the 20th century
zh: 如果莫內想在20世紀仍具影響力，他的新作品必須產生衝擊
ja: モネが20世紀でも重要であり続けるためには、新作が影響力を持つ必要がありました
local: His new works needed to have an impact if Monet was to be as relevant in the 20th century
ja_pron: Mone ga nijusseiki demo jūyō de ari tsuzukeru tame ni wa, shinsaku ga eikyō-ryoku o motsu hitsuyō ga arimashita
native: His new works needed to have an impact if Monet was to be as relevant in the 20th century

en: as he was in the 19th century.
zh: 就像他在19世紀那樣。
ja: 19世紀のように。
local: as he was in the 19th century.
ja_pron: Jūkyū seiki no yō ni
native: as he was in the 19th century.

en: He decided to work on a scale he'd never attempted before.
zh: 他決定嘗試前所未有的規模。
ja: 彼はこれまで試みたことのない規模で制作することを決めました。
local: He decided to work on a scale he'd never attempted before.
ja_pron: Kare wa kore made kokoromi ta koto no nai kibo de seisaku suru koto o kimemashita
native: He decided to work on a scale he'd never attempted before.

en: His ambition was phenomenal.
zh: 他的雄心壯志非凡。
ja: 彼の野心は並外れていました。
local: His ambition was phenomenal.
ja_pron: Kare no yashin wa nami hazurete imashita
native: His ambition was phenomenal.

en: All eight panels would be the same height, but differ in length.
zh: 所有八個畫板高度相同，但長度不同。
ja: 8枚のパネルはすべて同じ高さですが、長さは異なります。
local: All eight panels would be the same height, but differ in length.
ja_pron: 8-mai no paneru wa subete onaji takasa desu ga, nagasa wa kotonarimasu
native: All eight panels would be the same height, but differ in length.

en: Together they would span a total length of 91 metres or 300 feet.
zh: 總長度將達91米或300英尺。
ja: 合計で91メートル、または300フィートの長さになります。
local: Together they would span a total length of 91 metres or 300 feet.
ja_pron: Gōkei de 91 mētoru, mata wa 300 fīto no nagasa ni narimasu
native: Together they would span a total length of 91 metres or 300 feet.

en: The first task was to build a new studio to accommodate the huge canvases, with space
zh: 第一個任務是建造一個新工作室，以容納巨大的畫布，並有空間
ja: 最初の課題は巨大なキャンバスを収容するための新しいスタジオを建てることでした、スペースも確保して
local: The first task was to build a new studio to accommodate the huge canvases, with space
ja_pron: Saisho no kadai wa kyodai na kyanbasu o shūyō suru tame no atarashī sutajio o tateru koto deshita, supēsu mo kakuho shite
native: The first task was to build a new studio to accommodate the huge canvases, with space

en: enough for him to assess his work, with maximum possible light from top lighting.
zh: 足夠讓他評估作品，並從頂部照明獲得最大可能的光線。
ja: 彼が作品を評価できるように、上部からの最大限の光を取り入れるスペースもありました。
local: enough for him to assess his work, with maximum possible light from top lighting.
ja_pron: Kare ga sakuhin o hyōka dekiru yō ni, jōbu kara no saidaigen no hikari o toriireru supēsu mo arimashita
native: enough for him to assess his work, with maximum possible light from top lighting.

en: It is a myth that Monet painted all his canvases outside, a myth Monet himself propagated
zh: 莫內所有畫布都在戶外繪畫是個迷思，這是莫內自己散布的迷思
ja: モネがすべてのキャンバスを屋外で描いたというのは神話であり、それはモネ自身が広めた誤解です
local: It is a myth that Monet painted all his canvases outside, a myth Monet himself propagated
ja_pron: Mone ga subete no kyanbasu o okugai de kaita to iu no wa shinwa de ari, sore wa Mone jishin ga hirometa gokai desu
native: It is a myth that Monet painted all his canvases outside, a myth Monet himself propagated

en: when he famously claimed to not even have a studio.
zh: 當時他著名地聲稱自己甚至沒有工作室。
ja: 彼は有名なことに、自分にはスタジオすらないと主張していました。
local: when he famously claimed to not even have a studio.
ja_pron: Kare wa yūmei na koto ni, jibun ni wa sutajio sura nai to shuchō shite imashita
native: when he famously claimed to not even have a studio.

en: Most of Monet's paintings were started outside, but finished off in his studio.
zh: 莫內的大部分畫作是在戶外開始，但在他的工作室完成。
ja: モネの絵のほとんどは屋外で始められましたが、スタジオで仕上げられました。
local: Most of Monet's paintings were started outside, but finished off in his studio.
ja_pron: Mone no e no hotondo wa okugai de hajime raremashita ga, sutajio de shiage raremashita
native: Most of Monet's paintings were started outside, but finished off in his studio.

en: For these colossal paintings, Monet worked on up to 12 canvases at the same time, which
zh: 對於這些巨大的畫作，莫內同時在最多12幅畫布上工作，這些
ja: これらの巨大な絵画では、モネは最大12枚のキャンバスを同時に扱いました、それらは
local: For these colossal paintings, Monet worked on up to 12 canvases at the same time, which
ja_pron: Korera no kyodai na kaiga de wa, Mone wa saidai 12-mai no kyanbasu o dōji ni atsukaimashita, sorera wa
native: For these colossal paintings, Monet worked on up to 12 canvases at the same time, which

en: were placed on easels fitted with caster wheels, and rotated according to the light he was
zh: 被放置在裝有腳輪的畫架上，並根據他想捕捉的光線旋轉。
ja: キャスター付きのイーゼルに置かれ、彼が捉えようとする光に応じて回転しました。
local: were placed on easels fitted with caster wheels, and rotated according to the light he was
ja_pron: Kyasutā-tsuki no īzeru ni okare, kare ga toraeyō to suru hikari ni ōjite kaiten shimashita
native: were placed on easels fitted with caster wheels, and rotated according to the light he was

en: trying to capture.
zh: 試圖捕捉的光線。
ja: 捉えようとしている光です。
local: trying to capture.
ja_pron: Toraeyō to shite iru hikari desu
native: trying to capture.

en: It also allowed one canvas to dry as he worked on another.
zh: 這也讓一幅畫布在他工作另一幅時乾燥。
ja: また、一方のキャンバスを乾かしながら別のキャンバスに取り組むことができました。
local: It also allowed one canvas to dry as he worked on another.
ja_pron: Mata, ippō no kyanbasu o kawakashinagara betsu no kyanbasu ni torikumu koto ga dekimashita
native: It also allowed one canvas to dry as he worked on another.

en: A single canvas might take 60 sessions of intense work, and some were given as many as
zh: 一幅畫布可能需要60次密集的工作，有些甚至達到
ja: 一枚のキャンバスには60回もの集中作業が必要で、いくつかは
local: A single canvas might take 60 sessions of intense work, and some were given as many as
ja_pron: Ichimai no kyanbasu ni wa 60-kai mono shūchū sagyō ga hitsuyō de, ikutsu ka wa
native: A single canvas might take 60 sessions of intense work, and some were given as many as

en: 15 layers of paint.
zh: 15層油漆。
ja: 15層もの塗料が施されました。
local: 15 layers of paint.
ja_pron: 15-sō mono toryō ga hodokosaremashita
native: 15 layers of paint.

en: One visitor noted 75 paintbrushes and 40 boxes of pigments.
zh: 一位訪客注意到有75支畫筆和40盒顏料。
ja: ある訪問者は75本の筆と40箱の顔料を見ました。
local: One visitor noted 75 paintbrushes and 40 boxes of pigments.
ja_pron: Aru hōmon-sha wa 75-hon no fude to 40-hako no ganryō o mimashita
native: One visitor noted 75 paintbrushes and 40 boxes of pigments.

en: Monet chose canvases with a pronounced weave, whose weft threads were thicker than
zh: 莫內選擇了織紋明顯的畫布，經線比緯線粗。
ja: モネは織り目がはっきりしたキャンバスを選び、緯糸が経糸よりも太かったのです。
local: Monet chose canvases with a pronounced weave, whose weft threads were thicker than
ja_pron: Mone wa orime ga hakkiri shita kyanbasu o erabi, ito ga keito yori mo futokatta no desu
native: Monet chose canvases with a pronounced weave, whose weft threads were thicker than

en: the warp.
zh: 緯線。
ja: 経糸よりも太かったのです。
local: the warp.
ja_pron: Keito yori mo futokatta no desu
native: the warp.

en: He then applied a series of undercoats, letting them dry before applying another.
zh: 然後他塗了一系列底漆，讓它們乾燥後再塗另一層。
ja: その後、一連の下塗りを施し、乾かしてから次の層を塗りました。
local: He then applied a series of undercoats, letting them dry before applying another.
ja_pron: Sono ato, ichiren no shitazuri o hodokoshi, kawakashite kara tsugi no sō o nurimashita
native: He then applied a series of undercoats, letting them dry before applying another.

en: He would often scrape off paint to create an uneven surface that he would paint over once
zh: 他經常刮掉油漆，創造不平整的表面，然後再重新上色
ja: 彼はよく塗料を削り落として不均一な表面を作り、その上に再び塗りました。
local: He would often scrape off paint to create an uneven surface that he would paint over once
ja_pron: Kare wa yoku toryō o kezuri otoshite fukin'itsu na hyōmen o tsukuri, sono ue ni futatabi nurimashita
native: He would often scrape off paint to create an uneven surface that he would paint over once

en: again to get a sculptural effect.
zh: 以獲得雕塑般的效果。
ja: 彫刻のような効果を得るために。
local: again to get a sculptural effect.
ja_pron: Chōkoku no yō na kōka o eru tame ni
native: again to get a sculptural effect.

en: He brushed his paints on thickly, so that the canvas weaved trapped more of the pigment,
zh: 他厚厚地刷上油漆，使畫布織紋能捕捉更多顏料，
ja: 彼は絵の具を厚く塗り、キャンバスの織り目がより多くの顔料を捉えるようにしました。
local: He brushed his paints on thickly, so that the canvas weaved trapped more of the pigment,
ja_pron: Kare wa enogu o atsuku nuri, kyanbasu no orime ga yori ōku no ganryō o toraeru yō ni shimashita
native: He brushed his paints on thickly, so that the canvas weaved trapped more of the pigment,

en: and created what has been described as a texture of vibration.
zh: 並創造出被形容為震動質感的效果。
ja: そして振動のような質感を生み出しました。
local: and created what has been described as a texture of vibration.
ja_pron: Soshite shindō no yō na shitsukan o umidashimashita
native: and created what has been described as a texture of vibration.

en: He didn't lend colours over large areas, but rather did short strokes of colour side-by-side,
zh: 他沒有在大面積上混色，而是並排做短暫的色彩筆觸，
ja: 彼は広い範囲に色を塗るのではなく、隣り合わせに短い色の筆遣いをしました。
local: He didn't lend colours over large areas, but rather did short strokes of colour side-by-side,
ja_pron: Kare wa hiroi han'i ni iro o nuru no de wa naku, tonariawase ni mijikai iro no fudezukai o shimashita
native: He didn't lend colours over large areas, but rather did short strokes of colour side-by-side,

en: allowing the eye to mix those spots of colour at a distance.
zh: 讓眼睛在遠處混合那些色彩斑點。
ja: 遠くから見ると、目がそれらの色の斑点を混ぜ合わせるようにしました。
local: allowing the eye to mix those spots of colour at a distance.
ja_pron: Tōku kara miru to, me ga sorera no iro no hatten o mazeawaseru yō ni shimashita
native: allowing the eye to mix those spots of colour at a distance.

en: Here we can see the action that produced these dobs and dashes of broken colour.
zh: 在這裡我們可以看到產生這些斑點和斷續色彩的動作。
ja: ここで、これらの斑点や断続的な色彩を生み出す動きを見ることができます。
local: Here we can see the action that produced these dobs and dashes of broken colour.
ja_pron: Koko de, korera no hatten ya danzoku-teki na shikisai o umidasu ugoki o miru koto ga dekimasu
native: Here we can see the action that produced these dobs and dashes of broken colour.

en: As we see, sometimes the strokes are fairly short dashes, others are longer vertical strokes.
zh: 如我們所見，有時筆觸是相當短的斷續線，有時是較長的垂直筆觸。
ja: ご覧のように、筆遣いは時にかなり短い断続線であり、またある時は長い縦の筆遣いです。
local: As we see, sometimes the strokes are fairly short dashes, others are longer vertical strokes.
ja_pron: Goran no yō ni, fudezukai wa toki ni kanari mijikai danzoku-sen de ari, mata aru toki wa nagai tate no fudezukai desu
native: As we see, sometimes the strokes are fairly short dashes, others are longer vertical strokes.

en: There is no blending or rubbing, just thrusts of the brush.
zh: 沒有混合或擦拭，只有刷子的推動。
ja: 混ぜたり擦ったりはせず、ただ筆を押し付けるだけです。
local: There is no blending or rubbing, just thrusts of the brush.
ja_pron: Mazetari kosuttari wa sezu, tada fude o oshitsukeru dake desu
native: There is no blending or rubbing, just thrusts of the brush.

en: The water lilies themselves are simple strokes, then he uses pale yellows and greens, a spot
zh: 睡蓮本身是簡單的筆觸，然後他使用淡黃色和綠色，點綴
ja: 睡蓮自体はシンプルな筆遣いで、淡い黄色や緑色を使い、アクセントとして
local: The water lilies themselves are simple strokes, then he uses pale yellows and greens, a spot
ja_pron: Suiren jitai wa shinpuru na fudezukai de, awai kiiro ya midori o tsukai, akusento to shite
native: The water lilies themselves are simple strokes, then he uses pale yellows and greens, a spot

en: of red or a dash of lilac, then vague strokes of blue to suggest shadows.
zh: 紅色點綴或淡紫色筆觸，然後用模糊的藍色筆觸暗示陰影。
ja: 赤や淡い紫の点を加え、影を示唆するためにぼんやりとした青の筆遣いをします。
local: of red or a dash of lilac, then vague strokes of blue to suggest shadows.
ja_pron: Aka ya awai murasaki no ten o kuwae, kage o shisa suru tame ni bonyari to shita ao no fudezukai o shimasu
native: of red or a dash of lilac, then vague strokes of blue to suggest shadows.

en: Our eyes do the rest.
zh: 剩下的由我們的眼睛完成。
ja: 残りは私たちの目が補います。
local: Our eyes do the rest.
ja_pron: Nokori wa watashitachi no me ga oginaimasu
native: Our eyes do the rest.

en: There is a key element missing from Monet's water lilies, the horizon, a fundamental element
zh: 莫內的睡蓮缺少一個關鍵元素，地平線，這是基本元素
ja: モネの睡蓮には重要な要素が欠けています。それは地平線であり、基本的な要素です
local: There is a key element missing from Monet's water lilies, the horizon, a fundamental element
ja_pron: Mone no suiren ni wa jūyō na yōso ga kakete imasu. Sore wa chiheisen de ari, kihonteki na yōso desu
native: There is a key element missing from Monet's water lilies, the horizon, a fundamental element

en: of western painting since there are naysons.
zh: 自從有奈森以來，這是西方繪畫的基本元素。
ja: ネイションズ以来、西洋絵画の基本的な要素です。
local: of western painting since there are naysons.
ja_pron: Neishonzu irai, seiyō kaiga no kihonteki na yōso desu
native: of western painting since there are naysons.

en: In paintings, particularly landscape paintings, the horizon orientates the viewer and
zh: 在繪畫中，特別是風景畫，地平線為觀者定位並
ja: 絵画、特に風景画では、地平線が鑑賞者の位置を定め、
local: In paintings, particularly landscape paintings, the horizon orientates the viewer and
ja_pron: Kaiga, toku ni fūkeiga de wa, chiheisen ga kanshōsha no ichi o sadame,
native: In paintings, particularly landscape paintings, the horizon orientates the viewer and

en: defines the space, showing the spatial relationships within the composition.
zh: 定義空間，顯示構圖中的空間關係。
ja: 空間を定義し、構図内の空間関係を示します。
local: defines the space, showing the spatial relationships within the composition.
ja_pron: Kūkan o teigi shi, kōzu-nai no kūkan kankei o shimeshimasu
native: defines the space, showing the spatial relationships within the composition.

en: By taking out the horizon, the water takes up the whole of the canvas from edge to edge.
zh: 去除地平線後，水面佔據了整個畫布的邊緣到邊緣。
ja: 地平線を取り除くことで、水面がキャンバス全体を端から端まで占めます。
local: By taking out the horizon, the water takes up the whole of the canvas from edge to edge.
ja_pron: Chiheisen o torinozoku koto de, suimen ga kyanbasu zentai o hashi kara hashi made shime masu
native: By taking out the horizon, the water takes up the whole of the canvas from edge to edge.

en: We are left with a vast field of unfathomable nothingness, of light, air and water.
zh: 我們剩下一片廣闊的不可測量的虛無，充滿光、空氣和水。
ja: 私たちは計り知れない無の広大な領域、光、空気、水だけが残されます。
local: We are left with a vast field of unfathomable nothingness, of light, air and water.
ja_pron: Watashitachi wa hakari shirenai mu no kōdai na ryōiki, hikari, kūki, mizu dake ga nokosaremasu
native: We are left with a vast field of unfathomable nothingness, of light, air and water.

en: We have no sense of scale.
zh: 我們沒有尺度感。
ja: 私たちはスケール感を持ちません。
local: We have no sense of scale.
ja_pron: Watashitachi wa sukēru-kan o mochimasen
native: We have no sense of scale.

en: Monet somehow positions us simultaneously floating above the water and looking at it head on.
zh: 莫內以某種方式讓我們同時漂浮在水面上方並正面觀看它。
ja: モネは私たちを水面の上に浮かびながら、正面から見ているように配置しています。
local: Monet somehow positions us simultaneously floating above the water and looking at it head on.
ja_pron: Mone wa watashitachi o suimen no ue ni ukabi nagara, shōmen kara mite iru yō ni haichi shite imasu
native: Monet somehow positions us simultaneously floating above the water and looking at it head on.

en: As a viewer, your eyes tend to roam the canvas, left and right up and down,
zh: 作為觀者，你的眼睛傾向於在畫布上左右上下游走，
ja: 鑑賞者として、あなたの目はキャンバスの左右上下をさまよいがちです。
local: As a viewer, your eyes tend to roam the canvas, left and right up and down,
ja_pron: Kanshōsha to shite, anata no me wa kyanbasu no sayū jōge o samayoi gachi desu
native: As a viewer, your eyes tend to roam the canvas, left and right up and down,

en: looking for a place to settle and anchor, wondering where the form you are focusing on
zh: 尋找一個可以安定和停泊的地方，想知道你專注的形狀
ja: 落ち着いて定着できる場所を探し、あなたが注目している形がどこからどこまでかを考えます。
local: looking for a place to settle and anchor, wondering where the form you are focusing on
ja_pron: Ochitsuite teichaku dekiru basho o sagashi, anata ga chūmoku shite iru katachi ga doko kara doko made ka o kangaemasu
native: looking for a place to settle and anchor, wondering where the form you are focusing on

en: quite begins and ends, and how exactly it is constructed.
zh: 到底從哪裡開始和結束，以及它是如何構造的。
ja: どこからどこまで始まり終わるのか、そしてそれがどのように構成されているのかを考えます。
local: quite begins and ends, and how exactly it is constructed.
ja_pron: Doko kara doko made hajimari owaru no ka, soshite sore ga dono yō ni kōsei sarete iru no ka o kangaemasu
native: quite begins and ends, and how exactly it is constructed.

en: This, for me, is why these works succeed so well as a warm memorial.
zh: 對我來說，這就是為什麼這些作品作為溫暖的紀念品如此成功。
ja: 私にとって、これがこれらの作品が温かい記念碑として非常に成功している理由です。
local: This, for me, is why these works succeed so well as a warm memorial.
ja_pron: Watashi ni totte, kore ga korera no sakuhin ga atatakai kinenhi to shite hijō ni seikō shite iru riyū desu
native: This, for me, is why these works succeed so well as a warm memorial.

en: The image that often comes to mind is the battle-ravaged landscape along the western front.
zh: 經常浮現腦海的畫面是西線戰場破壞的景象。
ja: よく思い浮かぶのは、西部戦線の戦場で荒廃した風景です。
local: The image that often comes to mind is the battle-ravaged landscape along the western front.
ja_pron: Yoku omoi ukabu no wa, seibu sensen no senjō de kōhai shita fūkei desu
native: The image that often comes to mind is the battle-ravaged landscape along the western front.

en: Like the paintings, those battlefields had no beginning or end, and no horizons.
zh: 像這些畫作一樣，那些戰場沒有開始或結束，也沒有地平線。
ja: これらの絵画のように、その戦場には始まりも終わりもなく、地平線もありませんでした。
local: Like the paintings, those battlefields had no beginning or end, and no horizons.
ja_pron: Korera no kaiga no yō ni, sono senjō ni wa hajimari mo owari mo naku, chiheisen mo arimasen deshita
native: Like the paintings, those battlefields had no beginning or end, and no horizons.

en: Time and space was forgotten, as soldiers were enveloped in the sea of mud,
zh: 時間和空間被遺忘，士兵們被泥海包圍，
ja: 時間と空間は忘れ去られ、兵士たちは泥の海に包まれていました。
local: Time and space was forgotten, as soldiers were enveloped in the sea of mud,
ja_pron: Jikan to kūkan wa wasuresarare, heishi-tachi wa doro no umi ni tsutsumarete imashita
native: Time and space was forgotten, as soldiers were enveloped in the sea of mud,

en: surrounded by waterlogged and surreal landscapes, which covered their field of vision.
zh: 被水淹和超現實的景觀包圍，覆蓋了他們的視野。
ja: 水浸しで超現実的な風景に囲まれ、彼らの視界を覆っていました。
local: surrounded by waterlogged and surreal landscapes, which covered their field of vision.
ja_pron: Mizubishin de chōgenjitsu-teki na fūkei ni kakomare, karera no shikai o ōtte imashita
native: surrounded by waterlogged and surreal landscapes, which covered their field of vision.

en: There is a sense of mourning in the work, particularly with the truncated weeping willow trees,
zh: 作品中有一種哀悼的感覺，特別是被截斷的垂柳樹，
ja: 作品には哀悼の感覚があり、特に切り詰められたシダレヤナギの木々にそれが表れています。
local: There is a sense of mourning in the work, particularly with the truncated weeping willow trees,
ja_pron: Sakuhin ni wa aitō no kankaku ga ari, toku ni kiritsumerareta shidareyanagi no kigi ni sore ga arawarete imasu
native: There is a sense of mourning in the work, particularly with the truncated weeping willow trees,

en: gathering us up in their embrace.
zh: 將我們聚集在他們的擁抱中。
ja: 私たちをその抱擁に包み込みます。
local: gathering us up in their embrace.
ja_pron: Watashitachi o sono hōyō ni tsutsumikomimasu
native: gathering us up in their embrace.

en: These paintings are, as Monet intended, not only symbolic of the loss of the glorious
zh: 這些畫作正如莫內所意，不僅象徵著光榮的失落
ja: これらの絵画は、モネの意図した通り、栄光ある者たちの喪失の象徴であるだけでなく、
local: These paintings are, as Monet intended, not only symbolic of the loss of the glorious
ja_pron: Korera no kaiga wa, Mone no ito shita tōri, eikō aru monotachi no sōshitsu no shōchō de aru dake de naku,
native: These paintings are, as Monet intended, not only symbolic of the loss of the glorious

en: dead of the Great War, but perhaps all those people Monet had lost too.
zh: 偉大戰爭的逝者，也許還包括莫內失去的所有人。
ja: 大戦の戦没者だけでなく、おそらくモネが失ったすべての人々も象徴しています。
local: dead of the Great War, but perhaps all those people Monet had lost too.
ja_pron: Taisen no senbotsusha dake de naku, osoraku Mone ga ushinatta subete no hitobito mo shōchō shite imasu
native: dead of the Great War, but perhaps all those people Monet had lost too.

en: In 1912, Monet was diagnosed with cataracts, which worsened steadily over the years.
zh: 1912年，莫內被診斷出患有白內障，隨著時間逐漸惡化。
ja: 1912年、モネは白内障と診断され、年々悪化していきました。
local: In 1912, Monet was diagnosed with cataracts, which worsened steadily over the years.
ja_pron: 1912-nen, Mone wa hakunai-shō to shindan sare, nen-nen waruka shite ikimashita
native: In 1912, Monet was diagnosed with cataracts, which worsened steadily over the years.

en: For Monet, for whom color was everything, this was a tragedy.
zh: 對莫內來說，顏色就是一切，這是一場悲劇。
ja: 色彩がすべてであったモネにとって、これは悲劇でした。
local: For Monet, for whom color was everything, this was a tragedy.
ja_pron: Shikisai ga subete de atta Mone ni totte, kore wa higeki deshita
native: For Monet, for whom color was everything, this was a tragedy.

en: Age-related cataracts manifest as yellowing and darkening of the lens,
zh: 與年齡相關的白內障表現為晶狀體的泛黃和變暗，
ja: 加齢に伴う白内障は、レンズの黄変と暗化として現れます。
local: Age-related cataracts manifest as yellowing and darkening of the lens,
ja_pron: Karei ni tomonau hakunai-shō wa, renzu no ōhen to anka to shite arawaremasu
native: Age-related cataracts manifest as yellowing and darkening of the lens,

en: and have a major effect on color perception as well as visual sharpness.
zh: 並對色彩感知及視覺銳利度產生重大影響。
ja: 色の知覚や視覚の鮮明さに大きな影響を与えます。
local: and have a major effect on color perception as well as visual sharpness.
ja_pron: Iro no chikaku ya shikaku no senmei-sa ni ōkina eikyō o ataemasu
native: and have a major effect on color perception as well as visual sharpness.

en: If we look at this early painting by Monet, we can see that it is representative
zh: 如果我們看這幅莫內的早期畫作，我們可以看到它代表了
ja: このモネの初期の絵を見ると、それが代表的であることがわかります
local: If we look at this early painting by Monet, we can see that it is representative
ja_pron: Kono Mone no shoki no e o miru to, sore ga daihyō-teki de aru koto ga wakarimasu
native: If we look at this early painting by Monet, we can see that it is representative

en: of the colors and details of the actual bridge at Giovanni, but if we take the Japanese bridge
zh: 喬凡尼實際橋樑的色彩和細節，但如果我們取日本橋
ja: ジョヴァンニの実際の橋の色と細部を表していますが、日本の橋を取ると
local: of the colors and details of the actual bridge at Giovanni, but if we take the Japanese bridge
ja_pron: Jovanni no jissai no hashi no iro to saibū o arawashite imasu ga, Nihon no hashi o toru to
native: of the colors and details of the actual bridge at Giovanni, but if we take the Japanese bridge

en: and add a filter, we can get some idea of how Monet might have seen it tonally,
zh: 並加上濾鏡，我們可以大致了解莫內可能如何在色調上看到它，
ja: フィルターをかけると、モネがどのように色調的に見ていたかのイメージが得られます。
local: and add a filter, we can get some idea of how Monet might have seen it tonally,
ja_pron: Firutā o kakeru to, Mone ga dono yō ni shikichō-teki ni mite ita ka no imēji ga eraremasu
native: and add a filter, we can get some idea of how Monet might have seen it tonally,

en: after the cataracts developed. Monet could either paint a yellowish world,
zh: 白內障發展後。莫內可以畫出一個泛黃的世界，
ja: 白内障が進行した後、モネは黄色がかった世界を描くこともできました。
local: after the cataracts developed. Monet could either paint a yellowish world,
ja_pron: Hakunai-shō ga shinkō shita ato, Mone wa kiiro gatta sekai o kaku koto mo dekimashita
native: after the cataracts developed. Monet could either paint a yellowish world,

en: or he could compensate and neutralise the yellow by adding more blue pigment.
zh: 或者他可以通過添加更多藍色色素來補償和中和黃色。
ja: または、より多くの青い顔料を加えて黄色を補正し中和することもできました。
local: or he could compensate and neutralise the yellow by adding more blue pigment.
ja_pron: Mata wa, yori ōku no aoi ganryō o kuwaete kiiro o hosei shi chūwa suru koto mo dekimashita
native: or he could compensate and neutralise the yellow by adding more blue pigment.

en: These late paintings show a predominant green blue tone,
zh: 這些晚期畫作顯示出主要的綠藍色調，
ja: これらの晩年の絵画は主に緑青色のトーンを示しています。
local: These late paintings show a predominant green blue tone,
ja_pron: Korera no banken no kaiga wa omo ni ryokushoku no tōn o shimeshite imasu
native: These late paintings show a predominant green blue tone,

en: that is quite different from the subtle color shading that characterises Monet's earlier impressionistic work.
zh: 這與莫內早期印象派作品中細膩的色彩陰影截然不同。
ja: これはモネの初期の印象派作品の繊細な色彩の陰影とはかなり異なります。
local: that is quite different from the subtle color shading that characterises Monet's earlier impressionistic work.
ja_pron: Kore wa Mone no shoki no inshōha sakuhin no sensai na shikisai no in'ei to wa kanari kotonarimasu
native: that is quite different from the subtle color shading that characterises Monet's earlier impressionistic work.

en: On top of this, his cataract would blur his vision,
zh: 除此之外，他的白內障會使他的視力模糊，
ja: さらに、彼の白内障は視界をぼやけさせました。
local: On top of this, his cataract would blur his vision,
ja_pron: Sarani, kare no hakunai-shō wa shikai o boyake saremashita
native: On top of this, his cataract would blur his vision,

en: which may explain why the application of paint is more abstract.
zh: 這可能解釋了為什麼他的上色更抽象。
ja: これが塗料の塗り方がより抽象的である理由かもしれません。
local: which may explain why the application of paint is more abstract.
ja_pron: Kore ga toryō no nurikata ga yori chūshō-teki de aru riyū kamoshiremasen
native: which may explain why the application of paint is more abstract.

en: Less clear than it once was. These are, of course, aesthetic choices, but we know from Monet's
zh: 比以前不那麼清晰。當然，這些是美學選擇，但我們從莫內的
ja: かつてほど明確ではありません。これらはもちろん美的選択ですが、モネの
local: Less clear than it once was. These are, of course, aesthetic choices, but we know from Monet's
ja_pron: Katsute hodo meikaku de wa arimasen. Korera wa mochiron biteki sentaku desu ga, Mone no
native: Less clear than it once was. These are, of course, aesthetic choices, but we know from Monet's

en: own words that he could no longer see the details or make out colors.
zh: 親口說明他已無法看清細節或辨識顏色。
ja: 言葉から、彼はもはや細部を見ることも色を識別することもできなかったとわかります。
local: own words that he could no longer see the details or make out colors.
ja_pron: Kotoba kara, kare wa mohaya saibū o miru koto mo iro o shikibetsu suru koto mo dekinakatta to wakarimasu
native: own words that he could no longer see the details or make out colors.

en: With all these issues, it may explain his choice of working on such a large scale as a way to compensate.
zh: 有了這些問題，這可能解釋了他選擇以如此大規模工作作為補償的方式。
ja: これらの問題を踏まえ、彼が補償の方法としてこれほど大規模に制作することを選んだ理由かもしれません。
local: With all these issues, it may explain his choice of working on such a large scale as a way to compensate.
ja_pron: Korera no mondai o fumae, kare ga hoshō no hōhō to shite kore hodo daikibo ni seisaku suru koto o eranda riyū kamoshiremasen
native: With all these issues, it may explain his choice of working on such a large scale as a way to compensate.

en: Coswading Monet to make the paintings was easy. Coswading him to part with them was the difficult bit.
zh: 說服莫內創作畫作很容易，說服他放棄它們才是困難的部分。
ja: モネに絵を描かせるのは簡単でしたが、それらを手放させるのが難しい部分でした。
local: Coswading Monet to make the paintings was easy. Coswading him to part with them was the difficult bit.
ja_pron: Mone ni e o kakaseru no wa kantan deshita ga, sorera o tebanasaseru no ga muzukashii bubun deshita
native: Coswading Monet to make the paintings was easy. Coswading him to part with them was the difficult bit.

en: It was up to Clemonso to arrange the transfer of the artworks from Giovanni,
zh: 安排從喬凡尼轉移藝術品是克萊蒙索的責任，
ja: ジョヴァンニからの作品の移送を手配するのはクレモンソーの役割でした。
local: It was up to Clemonso to arrange the transfer of the artworks from Giovanni,
ja_pron: Jovanni kara no sakuhin no isō o tehai suru no wa Kuremonsō no yakuwari deshita
native: It was up to Clemonso to arrange the transfer of the artworks from Giovanni,

en: a thankless task that tested their friendship.
zh: 這是一項吃力不討好的任務，考驗了他們的友誼。
ja: それは感謝されない仕事であり、彼らの友情を試しました。
local: a thankless task that tested their friendship.
ja_pron: Sore wa kansha sarenai shigoto de ari, karera no yūjō o tameshimashita
native: a thankless task that tested their friendship.

en: Clemonso, who had negotiated the Treaty of Versailles, drew on all his diplomatic skills, negotiating with the difficult Monet.
zh: 克萊蒙索曾談判凡爾賽條約，他運用所有外交技巧與難纏的莫內談判。
ja: ヴェルサイユ条約を交渉したクレモンソーは、難しいモネと交渉するためにすべての外交スキルを駆使しました。
local: Clemonso, who had negotiated the Treaty of Versailles, drew on all his diplomatic skills, negotiating with the difficult Monet.
ja_pron: Verusaiyu jōyaku o kōshō shita Kuremonsō wa, muzukashii Mone to kōshō suru tame ni subete no gaikō sukiru o kushimashita
native: Clemonso, who had negotiated the Treaty of Versailles, drew on all his diplomatic skills, negotiating with the difficult Monet.

en: The rooms at the aroggery were completed and ready for installation, but Monet hadn't delivered
zh: 畫廊的房間已完成並準備安裝，但莫內尚未交付
ja: アロジェリーの部屋は完成し設置の準備ができていましたが、モネはまだ作品を届けていませんでした。
local: The rooms at the aroggery were completed and ready for installation, but Monet hadn't delivered
ja_pron: Arojjerī no heya wa kansei shi setchi no junbi ga dekite imashita ga, Mone wa mada sakuhin o todokete imasen deshita
native: The rooms at the aroggery were completed and ready for installation, but Monet hadn't delivered

zh: 畫作。他不斷重做它們，似乎無法完成。夕陽畫布，

local: the paintings. He was constantly reworking them and seemed incapable of finishing. The setting
ja_pron: Kaiga o todokete imasen deshita. Kare wa taezu tenaoshi o shite ori, kansei dekinai yō deshita. Yūhi o kaita
native: the paintings. He was constantly reworking them and seemed incapable of finishing. The setting

zh: 例如夕陽畫布花了他兩年時間。它被一遍又一遍地重新上色，但莫內仍然
ja: 夕日のキャンバスは例えば2年かかりました。何度も塗り直されましたが、それでもモネは

native: sun canvas, for example, took him two years. It has been repainted over and over, but still Monet

en: left the lower right hand corner unfinished. Painting was keeping him alive. In the end,
zh: 留下了右下角未完成。繪畫讓他活著。最後，
ja: 右下の隅を未完成のままにした。絵を描くことが彼を生かしていた。結局、
local: left the lower right hand corner unfinished. Painting was keeping him alive. In the end,
ja_pron: Migi shita no sumi o mikansei no mama ni shita. E o kaku koto ga kare o ikashite ita. Kekkyoku,
native: left the lower right hand corner unfinished. Painting was keeping him alive. In the end,

en: Monet didn't let them out of his studio till after his death. Monet died on the 5th of December
zh: 莫內直到去世後才讓他們離開他的工作室。莫內於12月5日去世，
ja: モネは亡くなるまでそれらをスタジオから出さなかった。モネは12月5日に亡くなった、
local: Monet didn't let them out of his studio till after his death. Monet died on the 5th of December
ja_pron: Mone wa nakunaru made sorera o sutajio kara dasanakatta. Mone wa 12-gatsu 5-nichi ni nakunatta,
native: Monet didn't let them out of his studio till after his death. Monet died on the 5th of December

en: 1926 at the age of 86, with George Clemonso at his bedside holding his hand. The odd couple
zh: 1926年，享年86歲，喬治·克萊蒙索握著他的手陪伴在床邊。這對奇特的組合
ja: 1926年、86歳で、ジョージ・クレモンソが彼のそばで手を握っていた。その奇妙な二人組は
local: 1926 at the age of 86, with George Clemonso at his bedside holding his hand. The odd couple
ja_pron: 1926-nen, 86-sai de, Jōji Kuremonso ga kare no soba de te o nigitte ita. Sono kimyō na futarigumi wa
native: 1926 at the age of 86, with George Clemonso at his bedside holding his hand. The odd couple

en: had been friends for over six decades, and it was by far the most profound relationship of both
zh: 已經是超過六十年的朋友，這是他們兩人生命中最深刻的關係。
